arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, long smooth strokes, find your race rhythm.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back, current flips each leg. Goal fastest finish. 1) Settle to near pod critical power (~195-200 W shaft) after hot start; no ground pace targets (current flips). 2) Mid-race: test whether CP is higher: steady effort, watch heart-rate trend (levels off = below CP; keeps climbing = above). Use measure() on steady stretches. Raise effort a few % if HR flat. 3) Watch push_local minus push_along for weed (speed drops, pod same, HR same) or pod drift (pod changes but HR does not). Weed -> clear_rudder. 4) Final sprint from about 1000-1500 m out depending on reserve.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m, current ~0.3 m/s flips each leg (against on odd legs). Goal fastest finish. KNOWN: CP higher than calibrated (HR flat at ~218 W true); pod drifted ~1.2x high from ~650 s (pod_gain set; trust boat-model power + HR more than pod). Effort fades after a cue, so use chained pieces (+% vs current) to step effort up while HR trend stays near background ~0.6 bpm/min. Step up 5% at a time until HR climbs >2 bpm/min for 2+ min, then back off ~3% and hold. No ground pace targets (current flips). Watches: weed/drag (boat_to_pod drop with HR flat -> clear_rudder), pod drift changes, HR climbing. Final sprint ~1200-1500 m out, sized to reserve.
